description: Adds a language: puts it in targetLocales in localize.config.json (creating the file when missing), translates every message into it and adds it to the i18n setup localize.dev generated. Needs a localize.dev API key.

app.description: Monorepo: the app to work in (e.g. apps/web), relative to the repository root. Default: the root.

name: add_language
title: Add a language
